entries.ready_note: The SwiftUI overlay only adapts the icon service to views (the extract holds a placeholder staging text file). The job it fronts is the icon or thumbnail for a file or content type: the thumbnails service and its providers return the picture or the type icon, and sdk icon_images picks the best bitmap per content type with nearest-ancestor lookup. App icons are not cached as a system service (see the IconServices row).

entries.ready_note: Private SwiftUI pieces of the photo picker. The Photos app (library grid and selection) and the Notes camera-roll sheet (newest-first grid, thumbnails decoded off the UI thread, file-name search model) choose a photo from the folder library, and the SDK picker types (photo_picker) carry filters and the selection limit. Not mirrored: the source tabs for the vendor's Messages, Notes and Files apps (BifrOSt has one library), and the Notes sheet does not draw the search field yet.
